text:
```yaml
name: Spellcheck
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  spellcheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install codespell
        run: |
          python -m pip install codespell

      - name: Run spellcheck
        run: |
          codespell --ignore-words-list="crate,doc" --skip="*.lock,*.json,*.yml,*.yaml" .

      - name: Report issues
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "Spellcheck failed. Please fix the spelling errors above."
          exit 1
```
